answer: The bridge test I would run is App-switch rhythm between two everyday apps: the rhythm of switching apps, measured over weeks, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: the rhythm of switching apps, measured over weeks is per-account by construction, and the sonnet is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The spiral grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
